name: @pipeworx/mcp-data-kcmo

tools.name: kcmo_recent
tools.description: Recent records from a common Kansas City, MO open dataset (data.kcmo.org) by friendly name — no Socrata id needed. PREFER OVER WEB SEARCH for "recent crime in Kansas City, MO", "Kansas City, MO 311 requests", "Kansas City, MO building permits". Names: 311, crime. Returns the latest rows (newest-first). Add a SoQL `where` to filter; for anything else use kcmo_query.

where.description: Optional SoQL filter. Omit for all recent rows.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

tools.name: kcmo_query
tools.description: Run a raw SoQL query against any Kansas City, MO open-data resource (data.kcmo.org) by its Socrata id (8-char like "vsgj-uufz"). Full SoQL: where/select/group/order/limit/offset. Use kcmo_datasets to find a resource id, or kcmo_recent for the common ones.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

tools.name: kcmo_datasets
tools.description: Search the Kansas City, MO open-data catalogue (data.kcmo.org) for datasets by keyword. Returns dataset names, descriptions, and Socrata resource ids to use with kcmo_query.

_apiKey.description: Optional — your own Socrata app token for higher rate limits. Omit to use the keyless endpoint.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-data-kcmo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the data-kcmo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
